The former site of a fierce battle for control of this great city was waged here, and on this site is where it's citizens celebrate that victory. Statues of the fallen heroes, and great leaders of the alliance adorn the tops of grand marble archways leading in all directions. They stand ever vigilant against any unseen enemy. The people of Urda flock here to barter and trade, to converse with friends, or just relax near the fountain and have a game of chess. The former site of a fierce battle for control of this great city was waged here, and on this site is where it's citizens celebrate that victory. Statues of the fallen heroes, and great leaders of the alliance adorn the tops of grand marble archways leading in all directions. They stand ever vigilant against any unseen enemy. [Urda Town Square Center]
The former site of a fierce battle for control of this great city was waged here, and on this site is where it's citizens celebrate that victory. The people of Urda flock here to barter and trade, to converse with friends, or just relax near the fountain and have a game of chess. Benches and tables dot the landscape near the edge of the fountain. Hawkers of all type roll through this area with their wares, hoping to make a few coins. Languages of all races are spoken here. [Urda Town Square Center]
The former site of a fierce battle for control of this great city was waged here, and on this site is where it's citizens celebrate that victory. Statues of the fallen heroes, and great leaders of the alliance adorn the tops of grand marble archways leading in all directions. They stand ever vigilant against any unseen enemy. The people of Urda flock here to barter and trade, to converse with friends, or just relax near the fountain and have a game of chess. Benches and tables dot the landscape near the edge of the fountain. Hawkers of all type roll through this area with their wares, hoping to make a few coins. Languages of all races are spoken here. [Urda Town Square Center]
The former site of a fierce battle for control of this great city was waged here, and on this site is where it's citizens celebrate that victory. Statues of the fallen heroes, and great leaders of the alliance adorn the tops of grand marble archways leading in all directions. They stand ever vigilant against any unseen enemy. The people of Urda flock here to barter and trade, to converse with friends, or just relax near the fountain and have a game of chess. Benches and tables dot the landscape near the edge of the fountain. Hawkers of all type roll through this area with their wares, hoping to make a few coins. Languages of all races are spoken here. The sheer din of the crowd reverberates throughout the area. Passersby stop to admire the detail of the arches as they enter and exit the city square.

The area is illuminated.

[Urda Town Square Center]
The former site of a fierce battle for control of this great city was waged here, and on this site is where it's citizens celebrate that victory. Statues of the fallen heroes, and great leaders of the alliance adorn the tops of grand marble archways leading in all directions. They stand ever vigilant against any unseen enemy. The people of Urda flock here to barter and trade, to converse with friends, or just relax near the fountain and have a game of chess. Benches and tables dot the landscape near the edge of the fountain. Hawkers of all type roll through this area with their wares, hoping to make a few coins. Languages of all races are spoken here. The sheer din of the crowd reverberates throughout the area. Passersby stop to admire the detail of the arches as they enter and exit the city square.

The former site of a fierce battle for control of this great city was waged here, and on this site is where it's citizens celebrate that victory. Statues of the fallen heroes, and great leaders of the alliance adorn the tops of grand marble archways leading in all directions. They stand ever vigilant against any unseen enemy. The people of Urda flock here to barter and trade, to converse with friends, or just relax near the fountain and have a game of chess. Benches and tables dot the landscape near the edge of the fountain. Hawkers of all type roll through this area with their wares, hoping to make a few coins. Languages of all races are spoken here. The sheer din of the crowd reverberates throughout the area. Passersby stop to admire the detail of the arches as they enter and exit the city square.

The area is illuminated.

[Trainers Office]
This singular room is a hub of learning. It is lined with an array of doors, each leading into variously sized examination. Housed inside each of the small rooms is a teacher waiting to impart their knowledge upon trainees of all shapes and sizes. There is a simple pair of signs outside of each office, the first identifying the skill to be tested and the second explaining how one may practice the skill to improve if they have previously failed to advance a level. An iron staircase leads to an upper catwalk which provides access to other training areas in the building. Torches set along the walls in between the doors provide illumination across the room.

[North Central Hall]
The central hallway of the Heroes Guild is decorated with portraits and busts of heroes of the Old Kingdom.  The pictures fill up nearly every inch of available wall space with distinguished-looking Human men and women. Along the walls darkened bronze sconces illuminate the portraits. Each portrait bears a bronze plaque with a name etched upon it, but years of neglect have rendered them tarnished and unreadable. From the east, are the faint cries and shouts of pitched combat, and, as if on cue, another young cadet rushes in and immediately out, heading west to the healer's room.

[Healer]
A single harried-looking woman rushes about the hectic room dealing with the multitude of injuries that seem to keep cropping up. She glances up for a moment to register your presence, then the next she seems to ignore you and moves to another bed in the room. Blue magic flows from her arms and heals a particularly rough scrape another trainee has received before she turns to the one behind her, attempting to reattatch a lost limb. She speaks in a low husky voice, "If you need my help, please speak up!! Otherwise, stop crowding the room and attend to your studies, I have too much to do!" Once she finishes, she mutters darkly about the damned authorities refusing her an aide.

[Bridge]
The bridge over the river is a marvel of engineering. Columns made entirely of river stones support the massive cypress beams, each hewn from a single tree. Broad oak planks span the space between each beam with only the smallest of gaps between each plank. Since its construction, the bridge has become a favorite fishing spot for many a young boy looking to escape his choirs. Spotted jewelweed and monkey flowers grow along each of the river's banks.

[Dremsyl's Tower, Dining Room]
The remnants of a beautifully wrought iron chandelier hang from the roof, just above a decayed wooden table. The room is smaller than the main dining room, perhaps the personal dining area of the master of the tower. The tapestries that still hang on the walls reveal in faded color that they were once masterpieces. A sodden piece of cloth covers the floor beneath the rotten wood table, it appears to be the hide of some great furred beast, but the water has damaged it beyond recognition. Because of the awkward tilting of the tower, much of the water streaming through the rest of the first floor has made its way here. Years of corrosive water has finally worn away the thick stone wall and the water has at last found a way out of the tower via dozens of holes where large stones once were. The water cascades out the holes in a constant stream into a cavern so dark no amount of light seems able to penetrate it.

[Tower Entrance]
The tower is far more dilapidated on the inside than the outside first suggested. The scent of molding wood hangs heavy and oppressive in the motionless air. The air is moist and humid, and thousands of tiny insects have made their homes in the rotting wooden beams overhead, causing the stone ceiling to bow alarmingly. Watery mud drips into the room from the gaping hole in the rotting wooden doors, suggesting that the only way out is to dig through layers of muck. Muddy foot prints lead further into the ominous tower.

The area is illuminated.

[Dremsyl's Tower, First Floor Entryway]
The enclosed entrance opens up into a wide, rounded room. The walls are made of large stone blocks stacked precariously upon one another and determined plant life has forced its way through the mortar between the rocks and now grows unchecked across the walls and toward the towering ceiling. The floor here is steeply angled down toward the east, not surprising considering that the tower's foundation has begun to crumble from age and neglect.

The area is illuminated.

[Dremsyl's Tower, Dining Room]
The remnants of a beautifully wrought iron chandelier hang from the roof, just above a decayed wooden table. The room is smaller than the main dining room, perhaps the personal dining area of the master of the tower. The tapestries that still hang on the walls reveal in faded color that they were once masterpieces. A sodden piece of cloth covers the floor beneath the rotten wood table, it appears to be the hide of some great furred beast, but the water has damaged it beyond recognition. Because of the awkward tilting of the tower, much of the water streaming through the rest of the first floor has made its way here. Years of corrosive water has finally worn away the thick stone wall and the water has at last found a way out of the tower via dozens of holes where large stones once were. The water cascades out the holes in a constant stream into a cavern so dark no amount of light seems able to penetrate it.

Watery mud drips into the room from the gaping hole in the rotting wooden doors, suggesting that the only way out is to dig through layers of muck. Muddy foot prints lead further into the ominous tower.

The area is illuminated.

The tower is far more dilapidated on the inside than the outside first suggested. The scent of molding wood hangs heavy and oppressive in the motionless air. The air is moist and humid, and thousands of tiny insects have made their homes in the rotting wooden beams overhead, causing the stone ceiling to bow alarmingly. [Dremsyl's Tower, First Floor Entryway]
The enclosed entrance opens up into a wide, rounded room. The walls are made of large stone blocks stacked precariously upon one another and determined plant life has forced its way through the mortar between the rocks and now grows unchecked across the walls and toward the towering ceiling. The floor here is steeply angled down toward the east, not surprising considering that the tower's foundation has begun to crumble from age and neglect.

The area is illuminated.

[Urda Town Square Center]
The former site of a fierce battle for control of this great city was waged here, and on this site is where it's citizens celebrate that victory. Statues of the fallen heroes, and great leaders of the alliance adorn the tops of grand marble archways leading in all directions. They stand ever vigilant against any unseen enemy. The people of Urda flock here to barter and trade, to converse with friends, or just relax near the fountain and have a game of chess. Benches and tables dot the landscape near the edge of the fountain. Hawkers of all type roll through this area with their wares, hoping to make a few coins. Languages of all races are spoken here. The sheer din of the crowd reverberates throughout the area. Passersby stop to admire the detail of the arches as they enter and exit the city square.

The area is illuminated.

[Tooth and Claw]
Banners of the Eyranas, stuffed boar heads, mammoth tusks, large limb and ribcage bones, other assorted bone-wear, and more Galirrim goods line the leather-trimmed walls and wooden shelves of this master tailor's shop made for lupines. In the very center of the room is a fifteen feet high, wood-carved statue of a Galirrim in mid-claw, his gaping maw open wide in full snarl. His wood fur and body have been recently stained with a deep brown coating which shines, and still smells of mineral spirits and oils. Bone and bead silkroot dream-catchers adorn one wall, and holy symbols of many shapes and sizes cover another. Boldly sticking out from the back wall is a large counter made of oak and tree stumps which has also been recently stained, and next to it stands a local Galirrim barking and growling to the Galirrim tailor's assistant in Ululari. They appear to be arguing over an item of small value which the local holds in his claws, and is displeased with. The Galirrim assistant is covered in Galirrim woads, which have been dyed into his fur in various colors, shapes, designs and hidden Galirrim meanings. As you approach, he tilts his head to one side and nods to you, and then returns to the disgruntled Galirrim local.

The area is illuminated.
